entries.en: The storm snapped the radio aerial on the roof.
entries.zh: 暴风雨折断了屋顶上的无线电天线。

entries.en: The auto loan statement arrived with the monthly bills.
entries.zh: 汽车贷款结单与每月账单一起寄来了。

entries.en: The horizontal section shows the wall thickness at floor level.
entries.zh: 水平剖面图显示了地板高度处的墙体厚度。

entries.en: The tagged fox rarely left its home range.
entries.zh: 那只装有追踪标签的狐狸很少离开其活动范围。

entries.en: A rain barrel collects runoff beneath the gutter.
entries.zh: 一个雨水桶在檐沟下收集流下的雨水。

entries.en: The jeweler set a precious stone into the ring.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠把一颗宝石镶嵌进戒指。

entries.en: The farewell photographs left us all misty-eyed.
entries.zh: 那些告别照片让我们都泪眼蒙眬。

entries.en: A booking mix-up put both groups in the same room.
entries.zh: 一次预订差错把两个团体安排在了同一个房间。

entries.en: The violin's sound hole has a graceful curved outline.
entries.zh: 小提琴的音孔有着优美弯曲的轮廓。

entries.en: Every air traveler passed through the security checkpoint.
entries.zh: 每位航空旅客都通过了安全检查站。

entries.en: The observatory clock marks each sidereal hour.
entries.zh: 天文台的钟标示每一个恒星时小时。

entries.en: As a free lance, Jordan writes for several magazines.
entries.zh: 作为自由作家，乔丹为几家杂志撰稿。

entries.en: Rainwater filled the newly dug post hole.
entries.zh: 雨水灌满了新挖的柱洞。

entries.en: The compressed spring stores elastic potential energy.
entries.zh: 被压缩的弹簧储存着弹性势能。

entries.en: The archive contains wartime accounts of shell shock.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着战时有关战斗疲劳症的记述。
